generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents

itemList.description: Fabrication, galvanising and supply of High tensile steel tower materials. (Tower +stub weight) (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.18.1 & Page No.170) Tower. DD+0 Gadag-Bagalkot design
Fabrication, galvanising and supply of Mild steel tower materials. (Tower +stub weight) (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.18.2 & Page No.178) Tower. DD+0 Gadag-Bagalkot design
Supply of galvanized Bolts & Nuts. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.18.3 & Page No.178)
Number Plates. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.19.2)
Danger Boards. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.19.3)
Phase plate (Set of 6 No.). (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.19.1)
Circuit plates. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.19.2)

Grounding of tower including cost of 40mm dia 2.5mm thick, class "C" GI Pipe of 3meters length as per specifications, with 50x6mm GI flats 3meter long, salt, charcol including excavation charges. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.115, Sl.No.6a)
Earth bond 450mm long. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.43, Sl.No.19.4)
Drake ACSR.  (As per MWSR-2023-24, Page No.44, Sl No.20.4)
7/3.65 mm GI Wire for Ground conductor. (As per MWSR-2023-24, Page No.44, Sl No.20.7)
Insulator strings with clamps, Arcing horns and Hardware for Drake ACSR.                                  :Disc Insulators 120KN. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.45, Sl.No.21.2.29.9.7)

Insulator strings with clamps, Arcing horns and Hardware for Drake ACSR.                                  :Single Tension clamps with arcing horns suitable for Drake ACSR conductor. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.67, Sl.No.46.1)
Single tension clamps with arcing horns suitable for Ground conductor. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.67, Sl.No.46.1)
C- Type Wedge connectors suitable for Drake-Drake ACSR conductor. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.70, Sl.No.47.10.9)
Vibration dampers for Drake ACSR conductor. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.67, Sl.No.46.9)

Check survey to be conducted during construction stage: Conducting detailed check survey along the approved route duly following the route alignment, GPS Co-ordinates, mission of detailed line schedule, tower schedule, land schedule and comparing the same with respect to detailed survey report, bringing out the differences if any. 
Submission of contour maps for undulated/hilly tower. The work also includes marking corridor width in the field and computing the quantum of benching and revetment, preparation of detailed land schedule along the corridor on the digitized Revenue village maps indicating the Sy. Nos. falling within the corridor for the purpose of estimation of the land compensation, submission of detailed consolidated hard copy of reports of check survey in 6 sets along with soft copy for approval in all types of terrain per km.(As per MWSR 2023-24 Page No.155, Sl.No 3)
Sorting of tower parts made of fabricated angle iron. (As per MWSR-2024 Page No.168 & Page No.113, Sl.No.1.1a)
Setting of stub templates and aliging, dismantling and transporation of templates from one location to another location. (As per MWSR-2024, Page No.113, Sl.No.1.1.b)

Assembling & Erection of towers including tightening of bolts and nuts including loading, unloading at store & site. (Including the weight of stubs) (As per MWSR-2024, Page No.178 &  Page No.113, Sl.No.1.1c)

Revetting of tower Bolt ends by heating using dry-Acetylene gas & hammering to destroy threads so as to make the tower theft proof (Bolts at nodal points only to be selected & revetted up to heigth of bottom cross arm, as per the directions of field engineer). (As per MWSR-2024, Page No.113, Sl.No.1.1.d)
Welding of Bolt & nuts. (As per MWSR-2024 Page No.113, Sl.No.1.1.e)

Supplying and fixing GI angle iron 45x45x5mm (1Mtr length) with cleats, bolts & nuts as per specification and fixing above 0.5mts length each at inner and outer surface of tower to facilitate running of barbed wire. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.113, Sl.No.2.a)
Supplying and fixing Barbed wire as per specification. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.113, Sl.No.2.b)
Fixing Number Plates. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.113, Sl.No.3.b)
Fixing Danger Boards. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.113, Sl.No.3.a)
Fixing Phase plate. (Set of 6 No.)(As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.113, Sl.No.3.c)
Fixing Circuit plates. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.113, Sl.No.3d)
Grounding of tower with GI Pipe including the cost of GI pipe. (As per MWSR-2023-24 Page No.115, Sl.No.6a)

Stringing of ACSR Conductor / HPC without allowing the conductor to touch the ground and without damaging the conductor.
